kind.description: Which playbook: platform (default; Traefik, Authelia, the deployer, apps), edge or nas.

target.description: Where it runs: hetzner, multipass (a local VM) or home (a machine nothing creates).

domain.description: The server's domain; platform subdomains and the apps' hang off it.

age_key_file.description: The age identity that opens secrets.yml (SOPS); without it, SOPS's own default (SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE, ~/.config/sops/age/keys.txt).

apps.description: The apps this server runs (platform only).

ref.description: The branch to build and deploy (default main).

path.description: The app's root inside the repository (default .).

runtime.description: The fleet-selected deployment runtime (default compose; Swarm is not available yet).
